notes: Same router as 0.4.89; what changed is the release gate. It ran 14 tests, all about the configuration database surviving a reboot, and covered neither fault fixed in 0.4.89 -- UDP switching itself off on a forwarded port, and a rotated PPPoE session coming back without internet. It now runs 26, and counts them: a -run expression matching nothing still exits 0, so "everything passed" and "nothing ran" used to look identical, which is how three of its four original test names rotted away unnoticed.
